Candidate 4d548f2e09bc36ef51212f64 places the legacy transition outside scope. That is a question boundary, not proof that legacy applications fail the substantive conditions. Candidate b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa likewise answers only the substantive question.

The specific commencement provision supports 28 November 2025, while the introductory immediate-effect wording lacks a supplied publication date. The source does not establish a universal implementation-date test; candidate 4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e should clarify its linkage between assessment and proposed implementation.

The introductory reference to home-regulator supervision describes the measures' purpose. Item (ii) expressly requires home-jurisdiction compliance; importing item (i)'s separate supervision condition into item (ii) is not established.

The supplied dependency IDs have no descriptions or source hashes. Neither can reliably be mapped to the missing FAQs or other authorities. Applying the predicates to an actual change may additionally require applicable home-jurisdiction rules and SFC guidance on novel or complex features and local policy implications.

Preservation findings below concern individual claims within their typed questions. They do not validate the complete candidate, establish factual classifications, or determine notification, filing, post-vetting or overall compliance.
